name: Aiden Andrade
source:
The Protagonist of the story

Higly skilled in IT and robotics.

An expert in weapons and martial arts.

Childhood friend of Kindra

Ex-Boyfriend of Cassandra

Had to undergo 2 years of PTSD treatment due to Cassie's betrayal and has been sober ever since.

His mother was in the Army Special Forces, but got KIA.
